project_title: दैनिक जागरण शैली समाचार प्रबंधन एवं ८-पेज अखबार डैशबोर्ड (Unified Website & Newspaper CMS)

design_system.theme_archetype: Swiss Editorial & Traditional Newspaper BroadSheet Hybrid

font_rules: Use Martel/Noto Serif Devanagari for all broadsheet news headlines, subheadlines, and editorial pieces to match authentic Dainik Jagran print style.
Use Yantra Manav/Outfit for UI dashboard labels, buttons, tables, and analytics cards.
Ensure line-height (leading) for Hindi news body text is set to 1.6 to prevent Devanagari matras clipping.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Sidebar-driven layout with full fluid responsive area, gap-6 for metrics, high-density data tables.
spacing_and_layout.broadsheet_grid: Authentic 8-column newspaper grid (grid-cols-8 md:grid-cols-12) with vertical column borders, ear panels beside masthead, and clear section blocks.

modules_and_views.description: Real-time statistics of published news, draft queue, 8-page newspaper layout completion status tracker, recent articles, and reader views chart.
Full CRUD interface for writing and editing news stories with dual-destination tags (वेबसाइट, अखबार, या दोनों), custom column settings for newspaper, image uploader, and draft status toggle.

modules_and_views.title_hi: ८-पेज दैनिक जागरण अखबार व्यूअर एवं लेआउट एडिटर (8-Page Newspaper App)
modules_and_views.description: Interactive broadsheet replica of Dainik Jagran. Pages 1 to 8: Page 1 (मुख्य समाचार - Front Page), Page 2 (राष्ट्रीय एवं राज्य - National & State), Page 3 (सिटी - Local City News), Page 4 (विचार/संपादकीय - Editorial & Opinion), Page 5 (कारोबार - Business & Market), Page 6 (खेल - Sports), Page 7 (मनोरंजन/लाइफस्टाइल - Entertainment), Page 8 (विदेश/विशेष - World News & Special Feature). Admin can assign articles to grid slots, toggle column spans, edit lead headlines, and view print preview.
Add, edit, and organize news categories with color codes and order priority.
Reporter profiles, press designation (विशेष संवाददाता, ब्यूरो प्रमुख), article counter, and contact logs.

modules_and_views.title_hi: मीडिया लाइब्रेरी एवं फोटो अपलोड (Media Library)
modules_and_views.description: Drag-and-drop file image upload zone, filterable photo grid with captions, DPI/aspect ratio indicators for print vs web.
Moderate comments on published articles (अनुमोदित करें, स्पैम चिह्नित करें, हटाएं).
Detailed graphs showing web views vs print allocation, top categories, and author statistics using Recharts.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, select, modal trigger, table row, and page pagination element.
testing_and_accessibility.aria_support: Full keyboard navigation, Devanagari screen reader labels, WCAG AA high contrast ratios.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all JS components (App.js, sidebar, headers, modals, forms) use strict Hindi (Devanagari) labels and titles.
Import Google Fonts Martel and Yantra Manav in public/index.html or index.css for high-grade Devanagari serif and sans-serif rendering.

Build the 8-Page Dainik Jagran Newspaper viewer with high fidelity: include traditional Jagran red masthead ('दैनिक जागरण'), ear advertisement panels on top left/right, dateline info line, page number indicators (जैसे: 'जागरण विशेष - पृष्ठ ४'), lead headlines with drop caps, column division lines, photo captions, and advert blocks.
Provide interactive layout controls inside the Newspaper viewer so the admin can change which articles appear on Page 1 through Page 8, alter lead stories, and set article column width.
Support complete article creation/editing with image upload (or media library selector), target selection (वेबसाइट / अखबार / दोनों), category assignment, and author tags.
Include sample dummy Hindi news articles (e.g. राष्ट्रीय विकास, बजट, खेल, स्थानीय समाचार) pre-populated so all 8 pages of the newspaper look fully fleshed out immediately upon launch.
Make sure every interactive element has an explicit data-testid attribute for automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or dropdowns. Always use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous padding (p-4 to p-8) on form panels and card containers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.component_extension: Use standard .js files with React 19 and Tailwind CSS utility classes.
